sources.limitations: Corroborates L1-L14 values, one housing, speed 24, one-second cadence, 3.5-tile range, ground-and-air ranged single-target attack and no target preference; no client build or deterministic projectile contract is published.

support.note: The L1-L14 ranged parent, sourced 3.5-tile range and documented Wall-overreach use the shared Core range path; Headless, Viewer and RL consume that immutable GameData route.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only direct parent despite a frozen raw L1-L14 table and existing generic ranged Core path.
changed_values.replacement: The shared Core ranged parent is explicitly exercised at L14, including a documented target reachable beyond an intervening Wall, through focused Core, snapshot/replay and Headless CLI coverage.
changed_values.justification: The build-pinned secondary table and independent secondary statistics corroborate the direct parent. No projectile speed, line-of-sight, collision or timing rule is introduced.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines Archer projectile speed, launch origin, impact delay, wind-up, collision, hitbox, target loss, same-tick ordering, target ties or visual animation timing.

The current qualitative Wall-overreach statement does not define exact line-of-sight, Wall-intersection, boundary metric or pathing behavior; Core's existing range-only attack decision is not asserted as client geometry fidelity.
The current exact values and targeting contract are secondary; the consulted official TH18 note does not publish Archer-specific quantitative data.
conclusion: Archer L1-L14 is executable through shared Core, Headless, Viewer and RL as a ranged ground-and-air parent with source-documented reach beyond Walls. Projectile, wall-boundary geometry, timing, collision and visual fidelity remain partial.
